name: Astrea's Broken Heart
source:
Seeking work, you join an organization that pursues the supernatural. There, you are tested by unusual tasks and enigmatic colleagues. 

This wondrous place, however, does not require believers.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Astrea%27s_Broken_Heart]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
为了寻找工作，你加入了一个追求超自然现象的组织。在那里，你会接受不寻常的任务和神秘的同事的考验。

然而，这个奇妙的地方不需要信徒。

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/Astrea%27s_Broken_Heart]romance-club.fandom[/url]
